Verses.Text: Vanity of vanities, says Qoheleth, vanity of vanities! All things are vanity!
There is an appointed time for everything, and a time for every affair under the heavens.
A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to uproot the plant.
He has made everything appropriate to its time, and has put the timeless into their hearts, without men ever discovering, from beginning to end, the work which God has done.
Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is man's all; since God will bring to judgment every hidden deed, whether good or bad.
